text: Implemented typed trial/AOI rows bound to validated import, exact AOI assignment, detector card/config, analysis frame/clock plus sync evidence, exclusions, sample origins, warnings, canonical provenance, and SHA-256 input identity. Added kernel-free report/explain and fixed-schema RFC-4180 CRLF export with explicit missingness and lossless decode/re-encode. Final io suites: 17/17 JVM and 17/17 Scala.js; scalafmt check and checkBoundaries pass. Schema, row-order, quote-escaping, and provenance-loss mutants each failed on both platforms and were restored.
